column1: # Katakana loanwords that are normally wanted in Latin script.
# Two columns, tab-separated: katakana reading, English spelling. Only words
# whose English form a Japanese writer actually reaches for belong here —
# engineering vocabulary and business terms that are usually written in Latin
# script even in Japanese prose. Everyday loanwords that read naturally in
# katakana (パン, コーヒー, テレビ) are deliberately absent: offering `bread`
# for パン would be noise.
# One entry per reading. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
